biocs.name: PowerShell Suspicious Flags
biocs.description: PowerShell process started with -WindowStyle Hidden and -EncodedCommand flags
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-WindowStyle Hidden' and action_process_command_line contains '-EncodedCommand'
